subject: Remittance hash / split-settlement vendor enrollment for Odin Technologies
messages:
From: Amanda Perez <amanda@odintechnologies.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: finance@odintechnologies.com
Date: 2026-12-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor enrollment & PO mapping for split settlements

Hi Chloe,

Quick intro — I run AP operations for Odin Technologies. We're kicking off the vendor enrollment for Redwood so invoices tie cleanly into our PO and split-settlement workflow. A couple of items we need to get you into our AP system: 

- Completed vendor enrollment form (attached or via secure upload)
- Bank details (IBAN/ACH), remittance email, and preferred remittance format
- VAT certificate (EU suppliers) or W-9/W-8 as applicable
- A sample invoice that shows the required metadata fields: invoice_uuid, invoice_remit_hash, supplier_urn, po_uuid, and payee_fraction (for split payments)

To be compliant with our ERP reconciliation we require the invoice to include an invoice_remit_hash (SHA256 of invoice number + supplier_urn) and the PO reference to include the primary supplier_urn and any secondary payees separated by a semicolon. Example PO reference: PO-78321 | urn:redwood:acct:001;urn:edgeworks:acct:22

Could you confirm Redwood can provide the enrollment packet and a sample invoice in the required shape? Also please confirm whether Redwood needs a separate onboarding record to accept the 80/20 split to our reseller partner EdgeWorks — we can accept a single PO that instructs split settlement if the mapping CSV is provided.

I've attached our vendor enrollment policy for reference. If it helps we can open a secure upload for your finance team.

Thanks,
Amanda Perez
AP Operations | Odin Technologies
attachments: ODIN_Vendor_Policy_v2.pdf
From: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Perez <amanda@odintechnologies.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-11T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment & PO mapping for split settlements

Amanda,

Thanks for the clear checklist — we can meet the format requirements but a few clarifications so we prepare the right artifacts: 

1) Split settlement: Redwood is fine with the 80/20 split to EdgeWorks. We'll need the partner payee_urn for EdgeWorks and confirmation that Odin will accept a single invoice where our invoice lists payee_fraction=0.8 and EdgeWorks payee_fraction=0.2 (we will include both payees in supplier_urn).

2) Remit hash: we can generate invoice_remit_hash as SHA256(invoice_number + supplier_urn). Confirm whether you prefer hex or base64 output (we typically provide hex).

3) Bank details & tax forms: can provide IBAN and ACH variants; laura_bennett (cc) will own the KYC pack. Marcus (cc) will prepare a sample produced invoice and a mapping CSV that shows the expected PO -> payee split.

4) Upload: please send the secure upload link and any field-level validation rules (max length for supplier_urn, accepted characters for invoice_uuid).

We'll attach: VendorEnrollment-Redwood-Fillable.pdf (filled), Redwood-Sample-Invoice-ODIN-12345.pdf, and split-settlement-mapping.csv with the mapping example. We'll upload to your secure link once you confirm.

Action items:
- Amanda: confirm hex vs base64 for remit hash and provide EdgeWorks payee_urn
- Redwood (Laura/Marcus): finish KYC and sample invoice, upload by Friday 12/18

Best,
Chloe Martin
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference

Hi Chloe — thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications below: 

- Remit hash: hex is preferred (lowercase).
- EdgeWorks payee_urn: urn:edgeworks:acct:22 (we've looped partner-ops).
- Field limits: supplier_urn max 128 chars; invoice_uuid must be RFC4122-style UUID or our parser will reject it.
- payee_fraction must be a decimal between 0.0 and 1.0 and should sum to 1.0 across payees.
- VAT/tax: since Odin is EU-headquartered, we'll apply the reverse-charge treatment where applicable. For non-EU entities we will require appropriate W-8/W-9 forms.

Secure upload link: https://odintechnologies.secure-upload.com/xyZ123-upload (expires in 7 days). HubSpot record for this purchase: https://hubspot.com/contacts/ODIN-8421

I've attached the vendor policy and sample PO export for reference. We can provision a test payment once your sample invoice is uploaded and we confirm mapping.

Amanda Perez
AP Operations | Odin Technologies
attachments: ODIN_Vendor_Policy_v2.pdf, PO-Export-Example-78321.csv
From: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment & PO mapping for split settlements

Amanda —

Attached are the completed enrollment form and the sample artifacts you requested. Quick notes: 

- We generated invoice_remit_hash as lowercase hex (sha256) and included the algorithm comment on the invoice: sha256(lowercase_hex(invoice_number + supplier_urn)).
- Supplier URNs included for both payees: urn:redwood:acct:001;urn:edgeworks:acct:22 and payee_fraction values 0.8 / 0.2 in split-settlement-mapping.csv.
- Invoice UUIDs follow RFC4122 v4.
- Bank details: we included both IBAN and ACH rows in the enrollment form; laura will follow up with an encrypted bank statement if you need proof of account ownership.
- Tax evidence: Redwood provided EU VAT certificate and US W-9 for our US entity in the KYC pack.

We uploaded the files to your secure link and also attached them here for convenience: VendorEnrollment-Redwood-Fillable.pdf, Redwood-Sample-Invoice-ODIN-12345.pdf, split-settlement-mapping.csv. Could you kick off a test payment (small amount) once you ingest them so we can confirm the split is processed as expected?

If Odin needs anything differently (e.g., base64 hash or separate vendor records per payee) let us know; otherwise we expect the test payment will validate everything.

Thanks for coordinating.

—
Chloe Martin
